passages.provision_quote: A firearm industry member shall not advertise, market, or arrange for placement of an advertising or marketing communication concerning any firearm-related product in a manner that is designed, intended, or reasonably appears to be attractive to minors.
passages.note: Restricts firearm advertising/marketing to minors; per annex this does not say which firearms may be owned, bought, or carried.
Lackey voted No on AB 2571 (advertising to minors); vote direction does not make an adjacent bill on-question (annex hard case).

rows.reasoning: The only source is AB 2571 (2021-2022), which restricts firearm advertising and marketing to minors; Lackey voted No on final passage. The annex states that rules about how guns are marketed or advertised do not speak to which firearms civilians may own, buy, or carry, and that a Yea and a No on such a bill are the same, so this passage is adjacent/off-axis regardless of vote direction and does not establish a rung.
